title: Nonnegative complex boundaries agree with derived triangle boundaries
statement: Let $C$ be an abelian category [def-sp-abelian] with derived category and localization $Q$ [def-weil-abstract-derived-category]. Let $S=(K_1\xrightarrow{f}K_2\xrightarrow{g}K_3)$ be a short exact sequence of $\mathbb N$-indexed cochain complexes. Write $E K$ for extension by zero to $\mathbb Z$, and let $e_K^n:H^n(Q(EK))\simeq H^n(K)$ be the composite of the canonical localization homology isomorphism and the extension homology isomorphism. Then $ES$ is short exact and, for every $n\in\mathbb N$, its derived triangle boundary [lem-weil-pbc-complex-ses-triangle] satisfies $e_{K_1}^{n+1}\circ\delta_{Q(ES)}^n=\delta_S^n\circ e_{K_3}^n$, where $\delta_S$ is the snake homology boundary [lem-weil-pbc-complex-ses-homology-long-exact].

proof.text: Extension preserves short exactness degreewise: in a nonnegative degree use ShortComplex.isoMk of the three extendXIso maps and the original exact row; in a negative degree use the splitting of the all-zero row. This is the private Lean lemma extension_shortExact.

Use the pinned Mathlib mappingCone.homologySequenceδ_triangleh cone-boundary formula, cancel the homotopy homology factor isomorphisms, and localize it via shiftMap_homologyFunctor_map_Q. Precompose by Q of descShortComplex, a quasi-isomorphism, and cancel it. descShortComplex_triangleOfSESδ identifies the resulting map with the derived SES boundary. This is integer_boundary.

Build an actual morphism of snake inputs from the extended sequence to the original one: its four rows use extendHomologyIso, extendOpcyclesIso, extendCyclesIso, and extendHomologyIso. Row commutativity follows from extension homology and cycle naturality; opcycle naturality is checked after the epimorphism pOpcycles. The first and last vertical squares are extendHomologyIso_hom_homologyι and homologyπ_extendHomologyIso_hom. For the middle square cancel pOpcycles and iCycles and use extend_d_eq. Apply ShortComplex.SnakeInput.naturality_δ. This is extension_boundary, valid also at n=0.

Compose the integer boundary formula with the extension snake-boundary equality and unfold the explicitly constructed e_K^n. The proof is complete in Lean, with only propext, Classical.choice, and Quot.sound.

theorem natComplex_boundary_derived
    {C : Type u} [Category.{v} C] [Abelian C] [HasDerivedCategory.{w} C]
    (S : ShortComplex (CochainComplex C ℕ)) (hS : S.ShortExact) :
    ∃ hExt : (S.map (ComplexShape.embeddingUpNat.extendFunctor C)).ShortExact,
      ∀ n : ℕ,
        DerivedCategory.HomologySequence.δ (DerivedCategory.triangleOfSES hExt)
            (n : ℤ) (n + 1) (by omega) ≫
            (natComplexDerivedHomologyIso S.X₁ (n + 1)).hom =
          (natComplexDerivedHomologyIso S.X₃ n).hom ≫ hS.δ n (n + 1) rfl
